profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Hello there, my name is Edwin and I am fortunate to have found a career that perfectly aligns with my problem-solving nature. When your career matches your personality, it's hard not to be having a great time! I strive to be an effective and positive force in every software team that I am a part of. I am fully engaged in all aspects of Software Engineering such as technical design, technical research, implementation (back-end  & front-end), software testing, and deployment. My career has been a blast and I have learned lots along the way!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Set up production deployment for our micro-service architecture using docker-compse and nginx as a reverse proxy.

Designed and developed the Simsei software suite featuring a REST API, a web application, and a self-hosted instance of Learning Locker LRS.

Web Client: Vue.js+ Vuex, Bootstrap-Vue
REST API: Java, Spring Boot, Spring Security, OAuth2, Spring Data Rest, Hibernate, MySQL, Mongo
Learning Locker: Node, Mongo

Created a data analysis tool that made use of techniques such as the Gradient Descent algorithm and K-means++. The tool featured a custom interpolator for 3D Time series data using cubic Bézier Splines.
Tools: Java & Cool Math :-)

Developed a learning management system web application using Spring MVC
Back End Tools: Java, Spring, Spring Security, Hibernate, MySQL
Front End Tools: JSP, Ajax, jQuery, Bootstrap

positions.title: SDET Intern
positions.description:
Developed a screenshot comparison tool that automated a large quantity of manual testing

Maintained the existing testing framework with automated test scenarios written in Ruby

Developed a tool that performs data quality checks and measures website performance using .HAR files

Combined the screenshot and performance tools into a robust command-line application

Tools: Ruby, Cucumber, RSpec

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern & Student Researcher
positions.description:
Cooperated with a team of four colleagues to develop an IntelliSense plug-in written in C# for Visual Studio to add support for Algol 60

Contracted by Unisys Corporation

Tools: Microsoft .NET, C#, ANTLR4, Unisys ClearPath MCP
